scope: Fixed genus five. Admissible paired cubic and a geometrically integral degree-four target pencil locus with a simply branched pencil and no g^1_3 or g^2_4. The result concerns an asymptotic bound.
statement: For the specified nonempty open of the paired-cubic genus-five hyperelliptic family over sufficiently large prime fields F_p, the discrete logarithm problem has expected bit complexity soft-O(p^(4/3)) with the Jacobian order supplied.
